title: Making sentences
intro: A sentence tells a complete idea. Its word order and verb help it make sense. Begin with a capital, use capitals for names and I, and put a full stop at the end of a statement.
support: جمله بشپړ فکر څرګندوي. د کلمو ترتیب او فعل ته پام وکړئ. د جملې پیل، نومونه او I په لوی توري ولیکئ.
text:
Mina sees a bird. The bird sees an ant.
I see a tree and a nest. Mina looks and I listen.
model: Mina names a person and sees shows an action. Introduce a bird, then say the bird. Use an before ant here. And joins a tree and a nest, or the statements Mina looks and I listen.
activity: Read the text and mark sentence boundaries. Say two new statements about the scene. Write them with clear spaces and full stops.
adult: Ask the child to explain word order, articles and what and links. Collect independent writing with a name, I and more than one sentence.
adultPs: له ماشومه د کلمو ترتیب او د نښو دنده وپوښتئ. د څو جملو خپله لیکنه وګورئ.

rounds.prompt: Build a statement with the words and its ending.
rounds.hint: Start with The, then name what sings.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.hint: Ant starts with a vowel sound.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Join these two parts: Mina looks ___ I listen.
rounds.hint: Choose the word that joins two ideas.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

tasks: Copy the first sentence. Circle the capital and the full stop.
Find the sentences that name Mina. Point to the verbs.
Put bird, The and sings in order and add an ending mark.
Choose a, an or the in: I see ___ apple. ___ apple is red.
Find what and joins in the two examples. Write your own pair of joined words.
Write two statements about home. Use I and a name.
Reread your two statements to an adult. Explain where you placed each full stop.
Write a sentence about a cat. Begin with a capital and end with a full stop.
Write two statements about a person and an object. Use a or an on first mention and the on the next.
Write three short sentences. Join two ideas using and. Check the verb, capitals and full stops.
